edit.description: assert the gate set's skip arms and the record-directory prefix guard

summary: Assert the harness gate set's three vacuous-by-design greens and its record-dir prefix guard in tests/harnessGates.test.ts

per.section: A green verdict is proven non-vacuous

acceptance: Each skip arm is asserted in its own case — verdict and skip reason — over a real commit, as the suite's other cases are.
pins: the per gate reports a drained queue as skipped, not as a judged green
the records gate reports a commit that touches no record as skipped
the records gate skips a state root resolved outside the repository
the records gate ignores a sibling directory that only prefixes a record directory
notes: Sites, all in harness/gates.ts: perGate's empty-queue skip (~208), recordsGate's no-record-in-span skip (~278) and relocated-root skip (~260), and the trailing-separator guard the dir globs are built with (~274). The suite is the sole driver of that module; harnessChain.test.ts only names the four.
